reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice with identical image, time (15–25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90), which looks like duplicated/erroneous data.
The third carousel card ('Smash Bros Bu…') has its title and image clipped by the viewport edge with no partial-peek padding, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles — the first has a white circular background with dark outline, the second has a dark/translucent background with white outline — an inconsistent component state.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar and its name/metadata is not visible, so the page appears to end mid-component.
Carousel cards in 'Fastest near you' omit rating information that is present on 'Popular right now' cards, making the two sections visually inconsistent.
The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', ...) is clipped mid-chip at the right edge and gives no visual affordance (fade/arrow) that more categories exist.
Placeholder-looking gray gradient thumbnails with clip-art plates in the 'Fastest near you' cards read as missing images compared to the richer imagery elsewhere.
